failure_summary.description: Missed the requested clue answer by choosing a related mechanism or entity, a synonym instead of the double-definition answer, a clue distractor, or True/False for a statement-form prompt.
Gave an over-specific subtype or an unnecessarily expanded name instead of the gold answer form.

patch.reasoning: The skill already covers statement-form prompts, exact double-definition answers, parenthetical length constraints, semantic answer slots, and concise answer granularity. These failures show those rules were not followed rather than a common missing rule, so adding overlapping guidance is not warranted.
